title: NEW (INTRODUCED BY THE CA-437 FIX): lint:hooks-shell's `while IFS= read -r -d ''` is the only bashism in any script body in this file, inside a BLOCKING job, contradicting the POSIX-sh-safe constraint the same file states at :276, :517-519 and :566-568; on an sh runner the loop never executes and the job fails with the misleading 'extraction/splitting regression, CA-437' message

NEW: #!/bin/bash is the only hardcoded-interpreter shebang among 12 sibling production/eval scripts, on the one file the PreToolUse git-commit hook depends on -- a host with no /bin/bash exits 126 (non-blocking, enforcement silently off) and on macOS the wrapper runs bash 3.2 while the edm-lint-artifacts it calls runs bash 5.x

NEW (INTRODUCED BY THE CA-448 FIX): CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is trusted on a bare -d test with no cross-check against the git toplevel, so an env-prefixed approve-gate -- a form that also bypasses the Bash(edm-state approve-gate*) literal-prefix ask matcher -- can stamp the enforcement tag permission-ask from settings that never governed the run, the false-present direction the function's own AC6 docstring forbids

NEW (RESIDUE OF THE CA-436 EXTRACTION): commit-time enforcement now depends on an executable bit that nothing asserts -- the hook's `command -v ... || exit 0` degrades to a silent no-op on a mode-0644 file, and the only -x assertion in bin/tests/ (wave7-smoke.sh:4570) covers timing.sh alone

CA-414 PARTIALLY FIXED: the printf-for-echo half is closed, but core.quotePath=false does NOT stop git C-quoting double quote, backslash or control bytes (only -z does), so the comment at :101-105 states a false premise and such a staged path still fails the awk root test / prefix filter and leaves its initiative unlinted with no diagnostic

CA-447 PARTIALLY FIXED: all six enumerated traps now carry HUP with signal-shaped exits and edm-lint-artifacts:137 gained its first-stage trap, but the prescribed cross-file sweep assertion did not land -- tiering-matrix.sh:154 is still RETURN EXIT INT TERM with no HUP, and score-artifacts.sh:756-757 still has an untrapped one-mktemp window

CA-448 PARTIALLY FIXED: project-root anchoring landed at :1056-1064, but the prescription's second half did not -- PERM_RULES_MISSING still names bare relative paths, so a prose-only enforcement tag remains unattributable to any resolved root

CA-413 VERIFIED FIXED: both sides are normalized with cd + pwd -P before the prefix comparison, with a documented fallback to the original string when cd fails; the A && B || C form is correct in all four branches

CA-436 VERIFIED FIXED: the hook body is extracted to bin/edm-lint-staged-artifacts, the remaining hook string is two fully-quoted statements with no SC2086 shape, and the intentional word-split now carries a real shellcheck directive at :127-128

CA-438 VERIFIED FIXED: the fd-200 rationale is pinned on BASH_XTRACEFD and 'Do not lower this' plus a tripwire for any sub-100 fd redirect onto the lockfile; independent full-scope sweep confirms 200> is still the only numeric fd in bin/, evals/ or hooks/

CA-443 and CA-444 VERIFIED FIXED: EDM_EVAL_KEEP_RUNS=0 clamps to 1 with a named warning at :192-195, and a non-numeric or zero EDM_EVAL_PHASE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is refused with exit 2 at :412-417, validated beside its default and documented at :34-35

CA-449 VERIFIED FIXED on its stated axis: cmd_compare uses TMPDIR-honoring XXXXXX templates with checked creation and a four-signal split trap, and the T61 tripwire at wave7-smoke.sh:1137 is widened to catch the bare mktemp file form

CA-130 reproduced a NINTH consecutive round: Write and Bash both absent from this lens's delivered tool set, so no file was written and no verification was executed; recorded per its do-not-re-file disposition
CA-111 unchanged: the two pinned digests and the floating bash:3.2 tag remain self-declared placeholders authorized in the file header
CA-123/CA-376 re-swept: flock's 200> is still the only numeric file descriptor anywhere in bin/, evals/ or hooks/ -- no fd 9, no 10-19 -- and the rationale is now both correct and test-pinned

CA-381 unchanged and not re-attempted: the five UserPromptExpansion $ARGUMENTS hooks carry a round-8 NOTED disposition recording that both candidate fixes were empirically tested and both broke gate enforcement

eval:nightly artifact retention (filed round 8, never promoted to a CA) downgraded to noted: the uploaded tree holds only frozen fixture artifacts and model output, the API key is never echoed or written, and GitLab masks the protected variable

set -uo pipefail without -e is provably required here (three command substitutions whose non-zero status is load-bearing at :44, :106 and :131-132) and matches run-eval.sh's CA-074 exception; only the rationale comment is missing

srd_root normalization re-derived against eleven adversarial values ('.', './', '././SRD', 'SRD/', 'SRD/.', '..', '../x', 'SRD/..', 'a/../b', empty, '..foo'): every traversal shape hits a named exit 1 and every benign shape normalizes; the SC2086 word-split at :129 stays safe because no glob or whitespace character is a letter or digit in any locale

Hardcoded-path sweep across every executable file under plugins/edm/ returns zero hits for /Users/, /home/, /opt/, /usr/local/, /var/local/ or the developer username; the only developer-machine paths remain the licence-provenance record already noted in round 8

Categories not applicable this round: no systemd units or init-managed daemon, no SQL, no caller-supplied-URL HTTP client, no secret written to disk; the npm install is version-pinned with --ignore-scripts correctly rejected and the reason recorded in place
